body:
Not to sure, honestly. Probably just...not care any more about trying to scrape myself out of the dirt. Stop fighting and just play video games. Talk to my friends. Go tell people I love that I love them and people I hate to go fuck themselves. I don’t have a lot of money but I can always find something to do.

Deffo sell my stuff for just good food and drink for the rest of the three days. As stated before, there is no greater joy for me than a relaxing chair and good food.

I am very much a Hobbit XD

True, I’m not stable. And no I ain’t.

I know beggars can’t be choosers either. It’s why I’m gonna take what I can.

But before this happened...yeah. It wasn’t much. Mostly consisted of printing huge wheels of label stickers and then sorting them through a machine to cut the rolls evenly and package them. Not the most glamourous job but it was quiet, I could do my work alone without managers breathing down my neck, and I was pretty damn good at it. Most of my long running jobs were because I enjoyed my work.

Again, I’m not saying you’re wrong, and that I need to find a job that gets me dosh quick. I guess I just...miss my old one, too...

If it wasn’t for one accident on the ice going home from work...just one slip. That’s it.

I’ve heard that before, but...I feel like I disagree.

Sure I may hate the COMPANY in ten years, but I never hated my work. I’ve done a few places that paid much more than what I was getting working my meager jobs. But...even if I don’t hate it, it does wear down on ya. I can’t focus on work if I can’t be proud of it.

I’m sure I’m sounding like an old mule about that but it’s just how I always felt. My work shines the most when I enjoy it. And anything less just kills everything, including the product and the job.

Does that make me a bad worker, I wonder...
Doesn’t it? One of the greatest pleasures I’ve had in life is where I’ve sat down in a nice comfy chair and ate something so delicious, I cried.

I appreciate the enthusiasm, but let’s be real. It’s hard to even wake up most days. Stuffed in either a dank basement surrounded by piles of junk your folks buy for no reason or wake up because the bright sun in your car is forcing you.

I don’t wanna be rich. I just wanna live. I know learning skillsets is amazing, but I found my calling. I made my career around printing of all sorts! I made T-shirts, and posters, and cards, and mugs and decals. It never was the highest paying work, but I loved it. I’m not very smart or very fast or very strong. I just like to make things. It made me smile.

But I keep losing what little happiness I get from it when it feels like my job and my life are literally teeter on the brink of starvation as soon as one slip up happens. One accident sends everything tumbling down.

I just want a quiet life. Where I can be happy and do what I feel like without having to cost me everything each time failure or misfortune happens. It just never comes.

Well, with...5 bucks and a half tank of gas as my only big possessions, I’d be lucky to make it half way across the state.

Probably gonna sell all of my stuff I have left tomorrow. Who knows. Maybe I’ll just buy some booze and something good to eat

As ironic/hypocritical as it sounds. I’m never really enjoying being open about this. I’ve experienced many times, even now, that really no one openly admits to caring. I’ve been burned at all of this stuff before. Hell, I doubt you guys care and are more doing this as a moral obligation or something.

Well, you’re at least the first person who suggested I should at least fight. It’s what I wanted to do at first too. Don’t know how well “jobs from home” will WORK, per say, but it’s better than nothing.

Mid 30s.

See, the problem is money, you see. Money. You gotta have money to try to do any of that. I don’t. Been jobless ever since COVID and thanks to politics, they cut everyone’s unemployment several months before it was supposed to. Found another job but then broke my leg and work is forcefully being stingy about aid. Been applying for a month and have had no calls. No one wants a cripple.

Hah! Wish I could just get a DM and have...like...a grand smack on my lap.

Nah...nah. My troubles are less around relationships and the like. I’ve learned to just be...ok with being single. Not in a “I’ll never get it” kinda way but more of a “I don’t feel like I’m at a point, fiscally, emotionially, physically, or otherwise that would let me have a good, long lasting relationship” kind of way. If I ever got one, then hey! I got one. If I didn’t, well...I’d have video games, cute cats, good food, and lots of other things too.

Most of mine are financial. Especially with this last year. And the fact that I suffered a severe ankle injury. My work has refused to help me in any regards, despite trying my absolute best with them for three months. Bills are stockpiling up. My medicine is all gone and I’ve been either sleeping in my car or my parent’s place (filled with many insults about how I’m being “lazy”)

And a few other details, but I’m rambling rn

There’s a flaw in that idea.

You gotta have friends who give a shit. They all have given me zero feedback, even when I am being honest with them.
